text:
Sorry to see your new calathea looking a bit rough. Unfortunately, two yellow lower leaves in the first two weeks don't qualify for a replacement on their own. Yellowing of one or two older leaves in that window is normal transplant stress.

**If it gets worse, you're covered.** The Plant Care Guarantee runs for **30 days from delivery** (**90 days** if you're a Leafy Plus member and ordered while your membership was active). We'll send **one free replacement** if the plant dies or declines significantly despite reasonable care, which means:
- Losing more than a third of its leaves
- Stem or root rot
- Collapse

**To make a claim:** go to "My Orders" within the window and upload at least **two photos** (the whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within **2 business days**, and you don't need to send the plant back.

**In the meantime:**
- Keep it out of direct sun for the first week.
- Don't repot for 2-3 weeks. Repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days isn't covered by the guarantee.
- Water only when the top inch of soil is dry, since overwatering causes most early problems.

You can also chat with a Plant Care Specialist for free, Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm your local time, if you'd like advice on your plant's setup.
